description: This file implements auto-locking logic based on rate limiting, including functions for handling auto-lock triggers and locking user accounts via Prisma ORM, with external dependencies on Redis, Prisma, and logging libraries.

methods.name: handleAutoLock
methods.description: Handles auto-lock logic based on rate limit response, increments count in Redis, and locks user if threshold exceeded.

methods.name: lockUser
methods.description: Locks a user account based on identifier type (userId, email, apiKey) by updating the database record.
